audience: Owner-operators of 1–10 person contractor shops (roofing, fencing, remodel, general trade), US, 28–58
offer: 14-day free trial, no card required, plans from $29/mo
voice_rules: Plain, confident, never breathless. No marketing buzzwords.
Never say 'AI'. The feature is 'Smart Proposal'.
Specific, slightly-imperfect numbers over round marketing numbers.
No hi-vis yellow, hardhat icons, hammer mascots, or orange CTAs.
No purple gradients, sparkles, glassmorphism, mascots, or pastels.
